headline: Invoicely sends the invoice. docstoc writes the chase.
sub: Keep Invoicely for billing: add tone-matched follow-up drafts for the invoices that run late.
whatItIs: Invoicely is an online invoicing service for small businesses. At the time of writing its pricing page lists four plans: Free at $0 with 5 invoices a month and 3 saved clients, Basic at $9.99, Professional at $19.99 and Enterprise at $29.99. Higher plans raise the invoice and client limits and allow up to 25 team members. It connects to PayPal, Stripe, Authorize.net and Mollie, tracks time, expenses and mileage, and has mobile apps.
whereTheyAreStronger: Online payments: Invoicely lists PayPal, Stripe, Authorize.net and Mollie as gateways, so a client can pay from the invoice. docstoc does not take payments.
Time, expense and mileage tracking that can be turned into invoices or estimates. docstoc has no time tracking.
Recurring invoices, estimates, bills and multiple currencies in one invoicing tool.
A clear ladder of prices: $9.99, $19.99 and $29.99 a month, each with stated invoice, client and team limits.
whereDocstocFits: You already invoice somewhere and the problem is the email after the due date. docstoc drafts it, matched to how many days late the invoice is.
You want to try it without an account: the Free plan gives 5 AI drafts a month, from pasted invoices or a CSV.
You send from your own mailbox. docstoc never sends for you, so the reminder arrives in the same thread as your normal mail.
You also need contracts or notices: docstoc has 1,000+ free document templates and 28+ payment reminder templates.

comparison.docstoc: Drafting follow-up emails for overdue invoices, plus templates, certificates and SSL automation.

whenToChoose.competitor: Choose Invoicely if you want one tool to create invoices, take card or PayPal payments and track billable time, and its plan limits fit your client list. It is a billing tool first, with reminders as part of the package.
whenToChoose.docstoc: Choose docstoc if invoices already exist and you want better words for the late ones, or if you want free templates and file certificates alongside. Many people use both: Invoicely for billing, docstoc for the chase.

faq.q: Can I use docstoc with Invoicely?
faq.a: Yes. Export a CSV or download PDFs from Invoicely, then paste the overdue rows into docstoc or upload the CSV. docstoc does not log in to Invoicely and has no Invoicely connector.

faq.q: Does Invoicely already send payment reminders?
faq.a: Its site lists automatic payment reminders, but the pricing page does not show which plan includes them, so check your plan. docstoc differs in one way: each draft is written for how late the invoice is, and you review it before sending.

faq.q: Is docstoc cheaper than Invoicely?
faq.a: Not on every plan, and they do different jobs. At the time of writing Invoicely starts at $0 and docstoc Pro is $14.99 a month, between Invoicely's Basic and Professional prices. Compare what you need: invoicing and payments, or follow-up wording.

name: Billomat
titleTag: Billomat alternative for payment reminders | docstoc
metaDescription: Billomat is German online accounting with dunning. docstoc drafts English follow-up emails for overdue invoices, free to try.
headline: Billomat handles the Mahnwesen. docstoc drafts the email.
sub: For overdue invoices where you want your own words: reviewed, edited and sent from your inbox.
whatItIs: Billomat is online accounting software, available in English and German, for small and medium-sized businesses that do their own bookkeeping or work with an accountant. Its pricing page lists three plans in euros excluding VAT: Professional from 29 € a month (19 € billed yearly), Business from 39 € (29 €) and Enterprise from 119 € (99 €). It offers a 14 day trial with no card, automated dunning, and DATEV on higher plans.
whereTheyAreStronger: Dunning built for the German-speaking market: Billomat lists automated dunning as a popular feature, with reminders on all three plans and a debt collection add-on on higher ones.
DATEV connection on the higher plans, which matters if your tax adviser works in DATEV.
Accountant access and team collaboration, with extra users from 10 € a month each.
Invoice creation with mandatory fields in templates, receipt scanning on the mobile app and confirmations, delivery notes and invoices from offers.
whereDocstocFits: You write in English or want a message that does not look like a standard dunning stage.
You want to see and change the text before anything goes out. docstoc only drafts; you send.
You are not ready for a 29 € plan and want 5 free AI drafts a month first.
You also want contract templates, hashed file certificates or SSL automation.

whenToChoose.competitor: Choose Billomat if you invoice in Germany or Austria, need dunning stages and DATEV, and want accounting and invoices in one tool. Its automation fits routine, repeated cases.
whenToChoose.docstoc: Choose docstoc if you want a personal, English-language message for a specific late client, or a free way to start. Treat it as a side tool; docstoc is not legal advice or a collections agency.

faq.q: Does Billomat have a free plan?
faq.a: Not that its pricing page shows. It offers a 14 day free trial without a credit card, then paid plans. docstoc has a free plan of 5 AI drafts a month.

faq.q: Can docstoc replace Billomat's dunning?
faq.a: No. docstoc has no dunning stages, fees or Mahnung forms. It drafts reminder emails, which you send yourself. For formal German dunning, Billomat's feature is the better fit.

faq.q: How do I move overdue Billomat invoices into docstoc?
faq.a: Export open invoices from Billomat, then paste the overdue rows or upload a CSV into docstoc. There is no live connection between them.
